Quantum computing: codes and autonomous control.

Algebra and missing implementation

The entangler boundary belongs here.

The supplied searches found no gauge-preserving logical entangler in three tested transversal/pairwise Clifford families. This is a restricted-family obstruction, not a universal impossibility result. A complete noisy logical CNOT remains unestablished.

Scope of the method

Not established

A quantum platform, a protected X5 memory under general Pauli noise, an executed QPU experiment, a hardware-ready native 3D design, or an advantage over a matched baseline.

K₄ is planar. A tetrahedral drawing does not establish a coupling, timing, readout, or error-control benefit.
